description: This file implements a background task scheduling utility using threads, allowing delayed execution, rescheduling, cancellation, and immediate execution of tasks. It manages tasks via handles, maintains a linked list of active tasks, and includes thread synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: getDelayedTask
methods.description: Retrieves the delayedTask object associated with a given handle atomically.

methods.name: scheduleDelayTask
methods.description: Creates and schedules a one-time delayed task with specified delay, callback, and argument.

methods.name: scheduleTimeOfDayTask
methods.description: Schedules a task to run at a specific time of day.

methods.name: rescheduleDelayTask
methods.description: Reschedules an existing task with a new delay and units.

methods.name: isDelayTaskWaiting
methods.description: Checks if a task is still waiting for its delay to expire.

methods.name: cancelDelayTask
methods.description: Cancels a waiting task and returns its argument for cleanup.

methods.name: exceuteDelayTask
methods.description: Forces immediate execution of a task if it is still pending.

methods.name: finalizeTaskInternal
methods.description: Marks a task as ready to run immediately.

methods.name: computeWaitTime
methods.description: Calculates the wait time for a task based on its delay and units.

methods.name: runDelayTaskThread
methods.description: Thread function that manages waiting and executing a delayed task.

methods.name: listDeleteDelayTask
methods.description: Deletes and releases a delayedTask object from the list.

methods.name: releaseDelayTask
methods.description: Destroys mutexes and frees a delayedTask object.

methods.name: findDelayedTaskByHandle
methods.description: Comparison function to find a task by handle.

methods.name: assignHandle
methods.description: Generates a new unique handle for a task.
